title: git-vouch-migrate verify-continuity
description: Verify a person's continuity proof against pgpkeys@C: people/<h>.json.asc detached GPG signature over the exact person file by the migratedFrom key (expired-but-unrevoked accepted, D9: handle EXPKEYSIG explicitly), or the SSH key is the GPG key's auth subkey (binding verified by gpg). SSH side via importing git-vouch's own verification (never reimplemented). Reports duplicate fingerprint claims (D3).
acceptance_criteria: Tests with throwaway GPG keys: valid .asc passes; foreign key NO_PUBKEY fails; swapped SSH key fails; expired key passes; revoked key fails; auth-subkey reuse passes; two-key person file (any-one-key .sig) passes.
